5 British University Champs. 10 kms CC, Edinburgh: 2, S.Barden 29:48. Spencer finished just 4 seconds down on Gareth Turnbull, winner of the 3.9 kms race at Durham two weeks earlier.
Stuart Faben finished 3rd in the javelin which was what we hoped for and in the 5,000 metres Spencer Barden was up against a Frenchman with a best time over 20 seconds faster than his.

A smoothly running Yacin Yusuf opened up the lead to 28 seconds on his stint and with Spencer Barden running the fastest of the day, our advantage was over one and a quarter minutes by the time Spenny raised his arms aloft at the race end.
